PR (cited in the notes as #22035): fix: removed null security context from values.yaml to placate helm 3.17.1 [closed]
Closes #22034
Helm 3.17.1 is allowing invalid null `securityContext` in `values.yaml` for Redis, and causing an undesired diff in `upstream.yaml` which fails the CI.

Thanks @jsolana for helping find the root cause!
